observations.label: Confirmed contingent and quasi-fiscal exposures

Separately the ministry plans PT SMI on-lending to regional governments repaid from revenue-sharing transfers.

observations.label: Offline mobilisation event pool
observations.summary: Five consecutive days of protest 2026-08-27 to 08-31: nationwide demonstrations over the delayed asset-forfeiture bill, 322 arrests and one death in Jakarta on 08-28, a riot outside the parliament building on 08-29 with hundreds detained. The person killed belonged to the civil group GRIB Jaya, so this is no longer student-only. Still short of a regime-change demand and materially smaller than the August 2025 wave (10 dead, 3,000+ arrested); 08-27 was that wave's first anniversary.

observations.label: Online grievance proxy
observations.summary: Street heat fell to 24.2, the lowest since the series began, and opposition dropped back to 35.6 percent with all three sides falling together. Unions have already re-armed the next mobilisation around the 2027 minimum wage (+7.5-9.5 percent demand, October demonstrations threatened). GDELT both lines timed out this week; four sources cleared the coverage gate.
